blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 34 contains 33 verses. It opens with: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. It concludes with: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Jehovah their God. All his days they departed not from following Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
